apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (f := fun k => KdVPlan.weight s k * ‖f k‖^2)

  · simp [KdVPlan.cutoff, hk]
    exact mul_nonneg (yui_aux_0001 T gamma R s k).1.le (sq_nonneg _)
  · simp [KdVPlan.cutoff, hk]
· exact hf
